## Publication Information

**Date:** 1880

**Genre:** Fiction

**Publisher:** London and New York: Macmillan and Company.

**Notes:** The stories included were ‘The Boy Bishop’ (first publishedin  <i>MP</i> Christmas 1878, 620-624); ‘One will and three ways’ (<i>MP</i> Christmas 1877) 124-8; ‘Kaspar's summer dream’ (<i>MP</i> Christmas 1876, 16-34); ‘Buy a Broom’; ‘The Travels of Two Kits’; Selma's secret sighs’ (published under the pseudonym 'Euphemia Arrowsmith' in <i>MP</i> Christmas 1874, 97-108); ‘Our ghost at Fantford; ‘Anna's Wedding Cake’;<i> </i>‘Autobiography of Patty Applecheeks’; and ‘A Holiday Engagement; or, The Campbells are Coming’
